acceptance: Test bundle submission PR opened from an external fork into develop runs validate-submission.yml and posts its summary comment.
Heavy code-test lanes are skipped on that PR while required checks remain satisfiable.
Auto-merge is mechanically blocked (no-auto-merge / hold) until manual review.
After manual merge (or verified test bundle), the bundle appears in the next site-inputs bundle and passes deploy gates.
context: Step 6 of the owner-approved Option 1 corpus consolidation plan (2026-11-24). End-to-end verification of Step 2 on a real fork PR into develop.
description:
## Problem
Changes to `pull_request_target`, `ci-units.yml`, fork-PR required checks, and `no-auto-merge` guards cannot be proven purely by unit tests.

## Change (Step 6 of 6)
Open a test bundle submission PR from a fork into `develop` and verify end to end:
1. `validate-submission.yml` runs from trusted base code and posts its summary comment.
2. Heavy code-test lanes are skipped while required checks stay satisfiable.
3. Auto-merge is blocked mechanically (`no-auto-merge` / `hold`).
4. After manual merge, the bundle appears in the next `site-inputs` bundle and passes `benchbox-site` deploy gates.
